req.title: Emit OpenAPI schema
req.statement: The system shall serve an OpenAPI 3.x JSON specification at GET /openapi.json.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-017 requires GET /openapi.json to return HTTP 2xx with a valid OpenAPI 3.x JSON payload. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — happy path returns 200 with correct Content-Type and openapi/info keys; (2) boundary BVA — exact field values in the spec match the FastAPI app metadata (title, version, openapi version prefix); (3) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST) returns 405; (4) DT — response body is parseable JSON and contains the 'paths' key with at least one route; (5) BVA — openapi version string starts with '3.' confirming 3.x compliance. All tests use TestClient in-process, assert exact values, and are designed to catch constant-mutation, key-removal, and status-code-flip mutations.

tests.name: test_openapi_json_returns_200_with_json_content_type
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable from main
trace: R-PLAYER-017: system shall serve OpenAPI 3.x JSON at GET /openapi.json
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_returns_200_with_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/openapi.json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.headers['content-type']

test_openapi_json_returns_200_with_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_openapi_json_version_is_3x
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable from main
expected: The 'openapi' field value does not start with '2.' or '1.'
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_version_is_3x():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/openapi.json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    openapi_version = body['openapi']
    assert openapi_version.startswith('3.'), f"Expected 3.x, got {openapi_version}"
    assert not openapi_version.startswith('2.')
    assert not openapi_version.startswith('1.')

test_openapi_json_version_is_3x()
